first_activation_invalid_as_failure.definition: First directory-ordered activation per slot: completed INVALID_TRIAL becomes failure; completed VALID_TRIAL keeps its binary outcome. Unrun slots, unfinished first activations, duplicate-valid ambiguities and unknown outcomes are excluded. A later running rerun does not remove a completed first activation. This is separate from the completed-valid primary analysis.
